title: Non-Profit Organizations – AI Powered Registration Process
summary: The UAE ministry uses fine-tuned Sentence-BERT for bilingual name similarity, alongside conventional database and prohibited-term checks.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The tool uses fine-tuned Sentence-BERT to compare Arabic and English names and supports alternative-name suggestions. Conventional SQL queries, exact matches, and prohibited-term rules remain part of the workflow. The source reports functional acceptance tests but does not isolate an improvement from the learned component. The intended benefit is less manual checking and better semantic name assessment.
purpose: Assist nonprofit registration with learned bilingual name similarity and suggestions.
system: Non-Profit Organizations – AI Powered Registration Process

ratings.reason: Semantic checking and suggestions could improve registration work, but database connectivity and rule-test success do not establish an AI-produced efficiency or accuracy gain.
Improved nonprofit access through AI-assisted registration remains a prospective downstream benefit.

ai_role.statement: Fine-tuned Sentence-BERT provides semantic similarity beyond exact-match rules; the system also proposes alternative names.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 1: Non-Profit Organizations – AI Powered Registration Process

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: A bilingual AI model checks nonprofit-name similarity
